desc: Paper notes: the notes' button opens one (TTYD_NOTES_TEST, no relay; Rogueport's harbour): Mario stands by a gold note (+4), its balloon saying what opens it, and presses L (the game's L, which Mario doesn't use in the field): the balloon grows the choice Rate up / Rate down / Close, the game's arrow at Rate up; A rates it up (the relay's rules: +5, rated once), the balloon says so and offers Close alone; A closes it and Mario and the NPCs go on (held while it was open)
log_must: ^\[notes\] near t0: Hidden a Star Piece\? \(\+4\)
^\[notes\] drawn: .*balloon t0; text 'Hidden a Star Piece\?'; text '\+4'; prompt '[^']+: Read'
^\[notes\] drawn: .*opened t0; text 'Hidden a Star Piece\?'; text '\+4'; arrow; text 'Rate up'; text 'Rate down'; text 'Close'
^\[notes\] test: rate gor_00 t0 1: Rated: thank you\.
^\[notes\] drawn: .*opened t0; text 'Hidden a Star Piece\?'; text '\+5'; text 'Rated: thank you\.'; arrow; text 'Close'
^\[notes\] Mario and the NPCs go on \(keys held 0\)$
log_must_not: ^\[notes\] A by t0 was the game's
